title: 第260章 神威侯府的好日子才刚刚开始第259章 假惺惺
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 王大山居高临下的看着李清玉，这个刚才还不可一世的侯府主母此刻吓的连个屁都不敢放。
他顿时觉得一阵索然无味。
“真是个外强中干的老废物。”
王大山在心里暗自冷笑了一声。
他连再多看李清玉一眼的兴趣都没有了。
王大山慢慢的低下头，他的目光落在王渊身上。
看着王渊毫无骨气的模样，王大山眼神一冷。
“滚开。”
王大山直接抬起脚，一脚将脚底下的王渊给狠狠的踹了出去。
一声沉闷的巨响。
王渊整个人贴着青石板地面，直接被踹飞出去好几米远。
“哎哟！”
王渊疼的他差点当场昏死过去。
王大山慢慢的收回脚。
他拍了拍衣服上并不存在的灰尘，语气里透着让人胆寒的冷酷。
“放心吧。”
王大山冷冷的瞥了一眼地上的王渊，又看了一眼李清玉。
“你们神威侯府欠我的，我一笔一笔的全都会要回来。”
“今天。”
“我就先大发慈悲，留他一条狗命。”
“以后在这侯府里，老子有的是时间，再慢慢的跟他把这笔债给讨清！”
说完这句话。
王大山没有任何犹豫。
他直接转过身，大步流星的朝着神威侯府的大厅外面走去。
连头都没有回一下。
直到王大山的背影彻底走出了大厅的大门。
那股一直笼罩在李清玉头顶的恐怖压迫感，这才渐渐散去。
“渊儿！”
李清玉惊呼了一声。
连滚带爬的从桌子旁边扑了出去，直接扑到了王渊的身边。
李清玉看着地上满身是血的王渊，她颤抖着双手，想要去抱王渊。
“我可怜的渊儿啊！这个该死的王大山！”
“他简直就是个没有人性的畜生！怎么能对你下这种死手啊！”
李清玉看着王渊惨白的脸，心疼的直掉眼泪。
她紧紧的咬着牙，压低了声音。
“渊儿，你放心！娘绝对不会让你白受这个苦的，就算是拼了这条命，娘也一定会替你报仇！”
王渊根本听不进李清玉的安慰，他现在满脑子都只有钻心剜骨的剧痛。
content_en:
Wang Dashan looked down at Li Qingyu. The mistress of the Hou Mansion who was so arrogant just now was so scared that she didn't even dare to fart.
He suddenly felt dull.
"What an old good-for-nothing."
Wang Dashan sneered secretly in his heart.
He was no longer interested in looking at Li Qingyu anymore.
Wang Dashan slowly lowered his head, and his eyes fell on Wang Yuan.
Seeing Wang Yuan's spineless appearance, Wang Dashan's eyes turned cold.
"Go away."
Wang Dashan directly raised his foot and kicked Wang Yuan out from under his foot.
"Bang!"
A dull bang.
Wang Yuan's whole body was pressed against the bluestone floor and he was kicked several meters away.
"Ouch!"
Wang Yuan was in such pain that he almost fainted on the spot.
Wang Dashan slowly retracted his foot.
He patted the non-existent dust on his clothes, with a chilling coldness in his tone.
"Don't worry."
Wang Dashan glanced coldly at Wang Yuan on the ground, and then at Li Qingyu.
"Whatever your Shenwei Marquis Mansion owes me, I will get back everything one by one."
"Today."
"I will show mercy first and spare his life."
"From now on, I will have plenty of time in this prince's mansion, so I can slowly pay off this debt with him!"
Finish this sentence.
Wang Dashan did not hesitate.
He turned around directly and strode toward the outside of the hall of Shenwei Hou Mansion.
Didn't even look back.
Until Wang Dashan's back completely walked out of the hall door.
The terrifying oppressive feeling that had been hanging over Li Qingyu's head gradually dissipated.
"Yuan'er!"
Li Qingyu exclaimed.
He rolled and crawled out from the table and rushed directly to Wang Yuan's side.
Li Qingyu looked at Wang Yuan who was covered in blood on the ground. She trembled with her hands and wanted to hug Wang Yuan.
"My poor Yuan'er! This damn Wang Dashan!"
"He is simply an inhuman beast! How could he do this to you!"
Li Qingyu looked at Wang Yuan's pale face and shed tears of distress.
She gritted her teeth tightly and lowered her voice.
"Yuan'er, don't worry! Mom will never let you suffer this in vain. Even if you risk your life, I will definitely avenge you!"
Wang Yuan couldn't listen to Li Qingyu's comfort at all. All he could think about now was the excruciating pain.
"mother!"
title_en: Chapter 260 The good days of Shenwei Hou Mansion have just begun Chapter 259 Hypocrisy
